title: relgap registry entry
description: One file per tool in registry/<name>.yaml. Check an entry with `relgap registry lint`.

name.description: Canonical tool name; must match the file name.

aliases.description: Other names that resolve to this tool, such as tf or KUBECTL_VERSION.

min_relgap.description: Oldest relgap version that understands this entry.

scheme.description: How tags are parsed and ordered. Default loose.

extract.description: Regular expression for scheme regex; capture groups are joined with dots.

tag_prefix.description: Stripped from tags before parsing; tags without it are ignored.

exclude.description: Regular expression on the tag; matching tags are ignored.

universe.description: What defines the versions in a range. Default releases.

line.description: Default release line for the end of a range.

sources.description: Changelog sources, tried and merged in order. Empty means auto-discovery.

path_template.description: File path in the repo. Placeholders: {version}, {major}, {minor} (the minor number alone) and {tag}; upgrade-guide also has {prev_minor} (such as 3.5) and {prev_major}.

url_template.description: https URL on a host relgap allows (go.dev, docs.python.org, api.adoptium.net); same placeholders as path_template.

ref.description: Git ref; may be a template such as v{major}.{minor}.

heading.description: Regular expression for a version's heading; {version} is replaced first.

ignore_sections.description: Headings, or heading paths joined with " › ", whose entries are dropped. A heading matches when it equals the item or starts with it and a space.

from_heading.description: Heading whose section holds the upgrade notes.

content.description: web-doc: selector (tag, #id and .class without spaces) of the element to convert. Default main, else body.

strip.description: web-doc: selectors of elements dropped before converting, such as a.headerlink.

anchor.description: web-doc: id of a version's element on the page, with the path_template placeholders, such as go{version}.

json.description: structured-json: how each JSON document becomes entries.

items.description: Dotted path to the array of entries; empty means the document is the array.

heading.description: Field whose value groups entries under a heading, such as type.

text.description: Entry text with {field} placeholders, such as {category}: {description}.

link.description: Field holding a URL for the entry.

ecosystem.description: OSV ecosystem such as Go, npm, PyPI or crates.io. GIT takes the repository URL as name and queries the version's tag.

bin.description: Executable names that outdated --binaries looks for. Empty means the tool name.

breaking_markers.description: Literal text that marks an entry as breaking.
